name: W. R. Berkley

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (W. R. Berkley Corporation logo.svg)

description: W. R. Berkley is a collection of specialty commercial insurers, each focused on a niche (excess and surplus lines, environmental, accident and health, workers compensation, professional liability, surety, regional commercial), plus a reinsurance and monoline excess unit. 88 percent of net premiums written ($11.2 billion of $12.7 billion in 2025) comes from the Insurance segment. It sells mainly through independent agents and brokers and earns an underwriting profit plus investment income on premiums held until claims are paid. Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance holds about 14.7 percent of the shares under voting arrangements with the founding Berkley family.

employees.note: 8,804 individuals, of whom 8,678 were employed by subsidiaries (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Insurance
businessLines.how: Policyholders pay premiums on commercial and specialty personal policies placed by independent brokers and agents; profit is premiums earned less claims and expenses, plus investment income on float. Each unit prices to its own niche with an underwriting-profit target.
businessLines.description: Specialty and regional commercial insurance underwritten by separate operating units: excess and surplus lines (Admiral, Nautilus, Vela, Verus), environmental, accident and health, workers compensation, professional liability, surety, regional carriers (Acadia, Carolina Casualty, Continental Western) and international units.

revenue.note: Revenue; net premiums written $11,183.7M (FY2024 $10,549.6M); FY2024 revenue $11,181.5M. By gross premiums written: other liability 38.6%, short-tail lines 27.3%, auto 12.9%, professional liability 11.4%, workers compensation 9.8%

businessLines.name: Reinsurance & Monoline Excess
businessLines.how: Other insurers pay reinsurance premiums to lay off risk; earnings are premiums less claims plus investment income; competition in reinsurance is described as especially strong.
